about.title: About me
about.p1: I am a creative designer and freelance web developer, formerly based in Geneva and currently in Australia for one year. I help businesses create modern, high-performing, conversion-focused websites as well as their visual identity (logos, business cards, flyers, and digital assets).
about.p2: I am developing a particular expertise in the food and hospitality industry (restaurants, cafés, bars, caterers), a field I am passionate about where branding, visual identity, and customer experience are essential.
about.p3: Although I currently work with businesses across various industries, my goal is to increasingly support hospitality professionals by creating digital experiences that attract attention and drive reservations.
about.p4: Each project is tailor-made with a results-driven approach: attract, convince, and convert your customers through strategic design and an optimized user experience.

testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.text_1: I hired Mr. Arthur Barraud to redesign our workshop website. I am extremely satisfied with the result, which exceeded our expectations. Professional and insightful advice. Fast development and deployment. I highly recommend this young company!
testimonials.text_2: Honestly, I love this app! Super practical, especially as a complement to a traditional vision board. I can note ideas as soon as they come, update my goals at any time, and easily track my progress. Everything is always at hand, and seeing the chart and completed goals is extremely motivating. Simple, clear, and truly useful every day.
testimonials.text_3: A fast, professional, and perfectly executed website creation. CDO Multiservices now has a clear, modern, and efficient website designed to build trust and showcase our expertise. High-quality work delivered in a short timeframe, with great attention to detail and service.
